Actor Yash's Mother Responds to Remarks on His Stardom

Yash's mother, Pushpa, has responded to past remarks made by Allu Aravind that questioned the actor's stardom before his film 'KGF'. Pushpa stated that Yash is the son of a bus driver who rose to the top and is not a "terrorist." The comments from Aravind, which questioned Yash's pre-'KGF' fame, were brought up again in recent coverage.
